Rules / Formatting

SK0210 The using directives are not arranged

skala arrange would sort, place or remove using directives.

CategoryFormatting
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeSyntax
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseyes
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since2.0

Why

Sorting and placement are syntactic; removal is conservative and occurs only when the directive is unused in every loaded compilation containing the file. One id represents the fixed-point using block because the edits overlap and must be applied together.

Example

Instead of:

using System.Text;
using System;

Write:

using System;
using System.Text;

When it does not fire

No using is removed without semantic agreement from every owning compilation. In syntactic mode the directives are only sorted and placed.

Configuration

  • skala_sort_usings
  • skala_sort_usings_with_system_first
  • csharp_using_directive_placement
  • skala_keep_nontrivial_alias
  • skala_remove_only_unused_aliases
